Title: Counit of Spectrum Adjunction is Natural Transformation

Let $\mathbf \Omega : \mathbf{Top} \to \mathbf{Loc}$ denote the [[Definition:Locale of Open Sets Functor|locale of open sets functor]].

Let $\operatorname{Sp} : \mathbf{Loc} \to \mathbf{Top}$ denote the [[Definition:Spectrum Functor|spectrum functor]].

The [[Definition:Counit of Spectrum Adjunction|counit of spectrum adjunction]] $\sigma: \mathbf \Omega \operatorname{Sp} \to \operatorname{id}_{\mathbf{Loc}}$ is a [[Definition:Natural Transformation|natural transformation]].
